    "stubId": "concurrency-14",
    "topic": "concurrency",
    "slug": "semaphoreslim-release-without-acquire",
    "level": "senior",
    "type": "find-bug",
    "subtopic": "Locks",
    "angle": "Shows code using SemaphoreSlim(1, 1) where a method calls Wait(0) and releases in finally even when the wait returned false. A nested call then makes the outer Release throw SemaphoreFullException, and the reader must find the defect.",
    "answerHinge": "Release must run only when the wait succeeded. Releasing after a failed Wait pushes the count above maxCount, which throws SemaphoreFullException; without a max count it would silently admit extra holders.",
    "sources": [
      "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.threading.semaphoreslim.release",
      "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.threading.semaphoreslim"
    ]
  }
]
